native_chirality.interpretation: The naive bipartite incidence Dirac operator has paired left/right zero modes and index zero; its 30 zero modes are generically lifted by independent edge holonomies. It does not force unpaired Weyl fermions.
native_chirality.scope: This is a no-go for this specific naive square incidence Dirac, not a theorem excluding all modified overlap/domain-wall/chiral discretizations or Standard Model physics.
